chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿUbayd Allāh al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in performing prayer over funerals when the sun sets and when it rises; it is only seeking forgiveness.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer; here, the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْجَنَائِزِ: funerals or deceased persons over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.تَغِيبُ: sets or disappears, referring to the sun
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform the funeral prayer at sunrise or sunset?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there is no objection to performing salat over the deceased at the times of sunset and sunrise. The reason given is that the funeral prayer is essentially an act of seeking forgiveness, which clarifies its ruling in relation to those times.
